scope: Hosted CI and visitor-browser neural-model validation; no local author-machine model inference
fixture_policy: Synthetic RGB pixel patterns only; no patient images, names, rater coordinates or per-case predictions

hosted_required.requirement: Record source/checkpoint/ONNX SHA-256, actual input and output tensor shapes, normalization-buffer lineage, export/runtime versions and release URL. Fail if weights are missing or a placeholder is substituted.

Test RGB channel order, [0,1] scaling, ImageNet normalization, NCHW shape, 448x448 resize and EXIF orientation on synthetic nonsquare RGB fixtures. Separate pixel-resize differences from network differences.

On hosted CI, compare dropout-disabled PyTorch and ONNX outputs with identical preprocessed synthetic tensors. Inspect ten means, ten log variances/variances and original-pixel angles. Report observed maximum errors, not only a pass label.
hosted_required.note: These engineering gates must be evaluated against measured backend differences; they are not clinical error bounds.

hosted_required.requirement: Verify that all BatchNorm nodes use fixed checkpoint or explicitly identified training-re-estimated buffers, dropout runs do not change buffers, and input order does not change deterministic outputs. Do not use global model.train() for export.

Inspect ONNX graph for preserved stochastic operations including internal attention dropout; confirm repeated same-input inference produces nonidentical coordinate means and nonzero between-pass covariance. Fixed attention dropout plus variable explicit dropout is not full replay parity.

Retain all ten means and conditional variances from each common pass. Verify T-denominator covariance, within+between decomposition, original-coordinate scaling and P4 uncertainty. Quantiles must use a shared mixture component per joint draw.

Smoke-test actual WASM and WebGPU providers on hosted browser runners where available. If a provider cannot execute stochastic nodes, disable that provider for MC mode or explicitly label deterministic/conditional-only output; do not fabricate repeated-pass variation.

Require finite tensors and nonnegative variances; reject segment lengths <=1e-6 original-image pixels. Report invalid sample count and branch-boundary proximity. Do not silently clip coordinates into the image.

Measure hosted-browser cold model download, warm inference, 50-pass time and memory on synthetic fixtures. Verify cancellation/disposal and no localhost, author-machine or image-upload requests. Avoid interpreting hosted measurements as visitor performance guarantees.
Check deployed model asset HTTP status, byte count, hash, CORS, static-site route/base path and release-page URL. A deployed frontend without usable model files is not completed browser inference.
